1: Us shaks ke liye bura anjaam aur sakht azaab hai jo logon ki bakasrat gheebat karta hai aur unhein taane deta hai,
2: wohi jis ki waahid fikr maal jama karna aur usey ginna hai; us ki koi doosri fikr nahin.
3: Woh samajhta hai ke jo maal woh jama karta hai woh usey maut se bacha lega, aur woh is duniya ki zindagi mein hamesha rahega.
4: Maamla waisa nahin jaisa yeh nadan samajhta hai; usey zaroor jahannum ki us aag mein phenka jayega jo apni shiddat ki quwwat ki wajah se har us cheez ko peesti aur torti hai jo us mein phenki jaye.
5: Aey Rasool ﷺ, aap ko kya maloom ke yeh aag kya hai, jo har us cheez ko chakna-choor kar deti hai jo us mein phenki jaye?
6: Beshak woh Allah ki bhadkai hui aag hai,
7: woh aag jo logon ke jismon mein utar jaati hai yahan tak ke un ke dilon tak pahunch jaati hai.
8: Beshak woh un logon par band kar di jayegi jinhein us se azaab diya jayega,
9: ek lambe, daraaz arse ke liye, itna lamba ke woh us se kabhi nahin niklenge.
